title: Owl reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- owl body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="26" ry="28" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="64" rx="17" ry="19" fill="#D2A679"/>
  <!-- belly feather lines -->
  <path d="M40 55 Q50 60 60 55" fill="none" stroke="#B8865A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M38 62 Q50 67 62 62" fill="none" stroke="#B8865A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <path d="M39 69 Q50 74 61 69" fill="none" stroke="#B8865A" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="32" r="20" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <polygon points="34,18 30,6 40,14" fill="#6B4226"/>
  <polygon points="66,18 70,6 60,14" fill="#6B4226"/>
  <!-- eye discs -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="30" r="9" fill="#F5E6A8"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="30" r="9" fill="#F5E6A8"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="30" r="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="30" r="5" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="28" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61" cy="28" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <polygon points="47,37 53,37 50,43" fill="#FFA726"/>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx="22" cy="55" rx="8" ry="16" fill="#6B4226" transform="rotate(-10 22 55)"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="55" rx="8" ry="16" fill="#6B4226" transform="rotate(10 78 55)"/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g>
    <!-- left page -->
    <rect x="30" y="68" width="18" height="16" fill="#FFF8E7" transform="rotate(-8 39 76)"/>
    <!-- right page -->
    <rect x="50" y="68" width="18" height="16" fill="#FFF0D0" transform="rotate(8 59 76)"/>
    <!-- book spine -->
    <rect x="47" y="67" width="6" height="18" fill="#D84315"/>
    <!-- book cover edges -->
    <rect x="28" y="67" width="2" height="18" fill="#BF360C" transform="rotate(-8 29 76)"/>
    <rect x="70" y="67" width="2" height="18" fill="#BF360C" transform="rotate(8 71 76)"/>
    <!-- page lines -->
    <line x1="33" y1="73" x2="45" y2="71" stroke="#C9B896" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="33" y1="77" x2="45" y2="75" stroke="#C9B896" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="71" x2="67" y2="73" stroke="#C9B896" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="55" y1="75" x2="67" y2="77" stroke="#C9B896" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d="M40 84 L36 90 M40 84 L40 91 M40 84 L44 90" stroke="#FFA726" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 84 L56 90 M60 84 L60 91 M60 84 L64 90" stroke="#FFA726" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
